candidate.runtime: local authenticated FastAPI TestClient + SQLite; no browser/LLM/provider
candidate.supersedes_reason: The initial slice source reported a duplicate operation retry after a later edit as verified against the old audit and refreshed the mirror with the old content. 852aaf039 fixes that; 5eede13aa adds the remaining outcome controls with identical production code.

no_change.verification: truthful zero effect; no audit appended

controls.name: test_direct_put_is_verified_against_durable_material
controls.assertion: Normal PUT returns 200, status=verified, write_outcome=committed, exact audit_id; fresh readback has +1 audit, exact content and mirror

controls.name: test_direct_put_same_title_and_length_still_checks_exact_content
controls.assertion: Same title and same-length content are not sufficient; exact content is compared

controls.name: test_direct_put_duplicate_operation_is_idempotent
controls.assertion: Same operation_id twice: second is already_applied, same audit_id, verified, no second audit

controls.name: test_direct_put_byte_identical_without_operation_is_a_distinct_edit
controls.assertion: Byte-identical edits without an operation id append two distinct audits and both verify

controls.name: test_direct_restore_is_verified_and_append_only
controls.assertion: Restore verifies, restored_from is the target, +1 audit, provenance and restored content are durable

controls.name: test_direct_restore_no_change_is_truthful_and_adds_no_audit
controls.assertion: Restoring the current version reports no_change and appends nothing

controls.name: test_direct_put_duplicate_operation_after_later_edit_is_not_verified
controls.assertion: Duplicate retry after a later edit keeps the original audit_id, reports committed_unverified/refuted, adds no audit, and leaves the later audit and mirror intact

controls.name: test_direct_put_workspace_mismatch_is_committed_but_unverified
controls.assertion: Workspace mismatch: committed effect retained, committed_unverified, refuted, replay=do_not_repeat

controls.name: test_direct_put_stale_prior_audit_is_refused_without_effect
controls.assertion: Stale expected_prior_audit_id: HTTP 409, no audit appended

controls.name: test_direct_restore_foreign_canvas_is_refused_without_effect
controls.assertion: Foreign user's canvas: HTTP 404, no audit appended

controls.name: test_direct_put_oracle_unavailable_preserves_committed_identity
controls.assertion: Oracle returns None: committed audit retained, unavailable, replay=do_not_repeat

controls.name: test_direct_put_oracle_refuted_preserves_committed_identity
controls.assertion: Forced refutation: committed audit retained, refuted, replay=do_not_repeat

controls.name: test_direct_put_kill_switch_never_fabricates_verified
controls.assertion: Kill switch: committed_unverified/disabled, never verified

controls.name: test_direct_put_verifier_gets_no_request_session
controls.assertion: Captured verifier context has no request db; actor/canvas expectations are frozen

controls.name: test_direct_put_tenant_mismatch_is_committed_but_unverified
controls.assertion: Tenant mismatch: committed audit retained, committed_unverified/refuted

controls.name: test_direct_put_oracle_exception_preserves_committed_identity
controls.assertion: Oracle exception: committed audit retained, unavailable

controls.name: test_direct_restore_wrong_canvas_audit_is_refused_without_effect
controls.assertion: Audit from another canvas: HTTP 404, no audit appended

controls.name: test_direct_restore_old_identical_material_is_no_change
controls.assertion: An old audit with identical material is a truthful no_change, not a new version

controls.name: test_verifier_refuses_operation_mismatch
controls.assertion: Verifier refutes an audit whose operation_id differs from the frozen operation

controls.name: test_verifier_refuses_absent_audit
controls.assertion: Verifier refutes a missing audit id

controls.name: test_verifier_refuses_stale_mirror
controls.assertion: Verifier refutes an accepted audit whose canvas mirror is stale

controls.name: test_verifier_refuses_restore_target_mismatch
controls.assertion: Verifier refutes a restore whose restored_from differs from the frozen target

controls.name: test_direct_put_effect_unknown_keeps_identity
controls.assertion: A storage result that may have committed reports effect_unknown/unavailable, retains audit_id/operation_id, and says replay=do_not_repeat

controls.name: test_direct_restore_no_change_kill_switch_is_unverified_no_effect
controls.assertion: A no-change restore under the kill switch reports no_change_unverified/disabled, effect none, and appends no audit
